projects.title: NuFlix
projects.description:
This is my first app launched in the Apple App Store.

A new movie discovery app that focuses on immersing you in the experience. How many times have you come across an interesting movie and forget about it? The main feature of this app is the "My Movies" list where you can save any movie that you want, you can mark it watch later, give it a thumbs up, post it on social media too. When you do go out to the cinema you have a convenient place to find your closest theater, restaurant, and bar all in the same app.
